about: (2026-11-17, pipefix: 260 s -- the select comes at ~155 s of the game, the 150 s run ended on the menus, qa084.) playtest2 2026-11-16, the user's playtest item 13: 'Superstar Select, bottom right: the Random label (triangle + "Ra...") cut off by a white box' (screens\2026-11-16\elizabeth_ours_select.png; the user's picture shape is 16:9). Cause (playtest2): the lift dropped a parameter -- tools/lift/mips.py counts every `sw $sN, off($sp)` as a register kept for the caller, so a value passed on as a stack parameter looked unread and converted callers left the register out. The label is a menus' draw request: drawn with a stale a3 as its flags it moved right from game x ~237 to ~295 (QA hd_select 2026-11-13_141354 vs 2026-11-13_143823), past the picture's edge; at 16:9 the part past x 320 shows beside the picture (as the white box). hd_select's route (qa_versus 20); shots on the select. LOOK (1280 x 960): the yellow triangle and 'Random' whole, at about x 950..1100, y 850..890 (the upstream screenshot exe\WWFNoMercyRecomp\docs\screenshots\wrestler-select.png has it there); nothing cut at x 1280. Also 'Type 1', the name bar and '2P PRESS START' where 2026-11-13_122418 had them.
